Configure and create caller-owned workflow calendars.

CalendarManager(...)  # Constructor inherited or generated at runtime

#### Methods

##### `initialize` class method

```python
initialize(*, holiday_group: str | None, timezone: str) -> type[CalendarManager]
```

Replace the shared configuration used to create workflow calendars.

Args:
    holiday_group: Holiday group passed to ReferenceManager when a
        calendar is created. None or a blank string disables holiday
        loading. Nonblank values are stripped of surrounding whitespace.
    timezone: Nonblank timezone name passed to CalendarUtils during
        calendar creation. Surrounding whitespace is stripped; this
        method does not validate whether the timezone exists.

Returns:
    This manager class, allowing initialize(...).get_instance().

Raises:
    TypeError: If holiday_group is neither a string nor None.
    ValueError: If timezone is not a string or is blank.

Side effects:
    Replaces class-level configuration for subsequent get_instance()
    calls and logs the selected settings. Existing calendar instances
    are unchanged. No holiday data is loaded until get_instance() runs.
    Failed validation leaves the previous configuration intact.

##### `get_instance` class method

```python
get_instance() -> CalendarUtils
```

Create a caller-owned calendar from the current configuration.

Returns:
    A fresh CalendarUtils using the configured timezone and, when enabled,
    holidays loaded through ReferenceManager with case-insensitive containment.

Raises:
    RuntimeError: If CalendarManager is uninitialized, or holiday loading needs
        an uninitialized ReferenceManager.

Holiday loading queries Spark and collects dates to the driver on each call.
Reference-query and CalendarUtils construction errors propagate. No instance
is cached.
